pageDescription: Author Canvas RCE page templates styled with pantoken, with a live preview.
helpModalBody1: Pick a starter template, edit it like you would in the Canvas Rich Content Editor, then click Copy HTML and paste the result into a Canvas page (switch to the HTML editor view first). Canvas sanitizes pasted HTML server-side — this preview doesn't attempt to replicate that, so always verify the pasted result in Canvas.
helpModalBody2: Use Edit theme to change the CDN provider, theme, or mode, and to hand-edit the generated theme.css/theme.js before downloading them.
